findings.location: Paragraph beginning “God’s people had been instructed by Jeremiah…” (around Psalm 137 / Jeremiah references)
findings.source_quote: God’s people had been instructed by Jeremiah to build houses, plant gardens, and raise families.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the added timing/period phrase. Translate faithfully without introducing a specific historical marker not present in the source. For example: "하나님의 백성은 예레미야에게 집을 짓고, 정원을 심고, 자녀를 키우라고 명령받았습니다." Preserve the original sentence structure and do not add "여호야김 때에."
findings.translation_quote: 여호야김 때에 예레미야가 그들에게 집을 짓고, 정원을 심고, 자녀를 일으키라고 명령했음에도 불구하고 그들은 그 가치를 보지 못했습니다.
